metadata.case_name: DHILLON CHAMKAUR SINGH v. YIU SZE YUEN

injuries.description: fracture of left ankle lateral malleolus.
source: The diagnosis was fracture of left ankle lateral malleolus.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: Medical examination revealed tenderness and swelling over medial and lateral aspect of left ankle.
Distal neurovascular examination was intact and there was no compartment syndrome.
He could not stand on his left foot.
He could not stand or walk without 2 crutches for several months after the Accident.

pain in his left foot would increase whenever he walked or stood for 10 minutes. The pain would also radiate with climbing on stairs. He could not climb stairs for more than 9 to 10 steps without resting for 1 to 2 minutes.
The pain also affects his sleep.
X-ray showed that the fracture was healing in satisfactory alignment.
there was no tenderness and normal distal neurovascular status.
he has mild residual pain today that requires him to seek symptomatic relief of painkiller prescribed to him.

source: He was treated with a short leg complete dynacast and given physiotherapy.

Li Chi Sing v Equal Link Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: open reduction and internal fixation with plate and screws; left 11-cm scar at left malleolus; 14 sessions of physiotherapy; total sick leave of 166 days; fracture healed with good alignment.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lam Kam Fai v Yau Shing Scaffolding Co Ltd & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractured left distal fibula requiring surgery; walked with crutches for some 9 months; 4-month physiotherapy; readmitted 2 years later for 6 days for removal of implants.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ching Yuk Yee v Furniss Jacqueline Elizabeth & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: open reduction and internal fixation for left ankle fracture; later implant removal; diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder and depression.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tamang Tikaram v Tong Kee Company Limited & Others
comparable_cases.injury_description: minimally displaced fracture of right medial malleolus; received no operation; short leg dynacast worn for 7 weeks; hospitalised for 3 days; attended 19 sessions of physiotherapy and 17 sessions of occupational therapy; could walk without aid; no scar or deformity; reduced range of motion.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tsui Wai Ho v Pride Glory Limited trading as Ziti’s
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractured distal fibula requiring open reduction and internal fixation; 7 follow-ups; 13 sessions of physiotherapy and occupational therapy; operation for implant removal; fracture healed well with satisfactory range of movement; full recovery achieved 2 years after accident.
